export_evidence: ImportKey India customs records (https://importkey.com/countries/india/mtc-business-private-limited): "Total Shipments 1786 Records detected ... Latest Cargo 2026-02-26"; export leg row: "2026-02-23 | MTC BUSINESS PRIVATE LIMITED | MGK INTERNATIONAL INC | SHREDDED MAGNESIUM SCRAP AS PER ISRI WALNUT- NHAVA SHEVA SEA INNSA1, India | Indianapolis, UNITED STATES | 81042010 | BOL 9933081". Counter check: page header claims 1786 shipments / 122 trading partners / 130 ports; rows actually visible in the free view = 5 shipment rows (4 import + 1 export) plus 5 supplier and 5 buyer aggregate rows. Only ONE export-direction row was visible, so export volume cannot be quantified from the free view. Note the visible export HS is 81042010 (magnesium scrap), not the declared 720211/720230/720293; the declared ferro-alloy codes appear only on the import side (e.g. 72044900 alloy steel scrap import from MULTI TRADE LINKS (UK) LTD, BOL 7749966, 2026-02-25).
domestic_evidence: No public domestic-supply record could be retrieved: DuckDuckGo search tool returned connection errors on both attempts ("searx: <urlopen error [Errno 111] Connection refused"), and registry pages returned HTTP 403 (zaubacorp.com, thecompanycheck.com). No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report split was seen. GST turnover: null (not public in retrieved sources).
note: Role is trader/importer-exporter, not manufacturer: the customs record shows MTC BUSINESS PRIVATE LIMITED as buyer of nickel cathodes (MITSUI CO. LTD, Kobe, BOL 7770586, 2026-02-26, HS 75021000), molybdenum metal (ONISC GMBH, BOL 7728271, 2026-02-24, HS 81029400) and silicon metal (YIMING INTERNATIONAL (HK), BOL 7665014, 2026-02-21, HS 28046900), and as seller of magnesium scrap to MGK INTERNATIONAL INC (USA). Registered address in the customs data is Andheri (E), Mumbai, not Chhattisgarh as claimed. Declared HS 720211/720230/720293 (ferro-manganese/ferro-silicon) is NOT supported by any visible shipment row — actual traded codes seen are 75021000, 81029400, 28046900, 72044900, 81042010; per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground, HS should be corrected to the factual codes. Export activity is confirmed by a dated B/L with destination, but the single visible export row is thin evidence for a 1786-shipment profile; domestic supply side remains unverified ("следов поставок" по внутреннему рынку не найдено в доступных источниках). Revenue and export volume: null — not public in retrieved sources.
